base_member_text: sta(sta(:,2)==0)=NaN (L28) uses the column-2 zero mask as linear indices into the whole matrix, so it NaNs entries in column 1 (time) at the corresponding linear positions rather than the intended eta values in column 2 — a latent indexing bug unless the file is single-column-of-interest.
audit_member_text: Line 28 forms an N-by-1 logical mask from sta(:,2) but applies it as a one-subscript linear index to the whole sta matrix; for a multi-column matrix this targets the first N linear elements rather than explicitly sta(mask,2), so the plotted column-2 zeros remain unchanged while corresponding column-1 entries can become NaN (lines 28, 31).

base_member_text: The variable sta is overwritten from the data matrix to the label string inside the loop (L26 vs L32); harmless only because the data is reloaded each iteration.
Station files use 4-digit padding sta_0001 (L21) unlike the 5-digit field snapshots elsewhere; the FUNWAVE-TVD station output naming convention is assumed, not shown here.
Whether the G <k> label numbering matches the physical FRF gauge numbers or the reversed numbering used in plot_bathy_stations.m is not determinable from this file.

audit_member_text: The script writes into plots_movies at lines 46-47 without creating or checking that directory, so output depends on prior filesystem state.
